faq_heading: South Surrey and White Rock golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a South Surrey and White Rock golf course home cost?
faq.a: The 187 golf course houses that sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026 had a median of $1,778,000, with the middle half between $1,499,950 and $2,147,500. All South Surrey and White Rock detached houses had a median of $1,670,000.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: A detached house whose listing carries the Golf Course Nearby or Golf Course Dev. flag in Paragon. The listing agent enters it, so it covers homes near a course as well as on one.

faq.q: How fast do South Surrey and White Rock golf course homes sell?
faq.a: 24 days at a median, closing at 96.2% of list, with 6% over the list price. All South Surrey and White Rock houses took 32 days.

faq.q: Which South Surrey and White Rock neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Grandview had 38 sales with the flag, Morgan Creek 33 and Pacific Douglas 28 between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

Of 597 detached houses that sold in South Surrey and White Rock between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 187 (31%) carried a golf course flag. They sold for a median of $1,778,000, 6% above the $1,670,000 median for every South Surrey and White Rock house.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a South Surrey and White Rock golf course home

items.t: Ask how close the lot is to the course, and which side of the house faces it. In South Surrey and White Rock, 187 sales carried the flag, and a house on a fairway is not the same as one a few blocks away. Grandview had the most golf-course sales (38).

Look at the fence, windows and deck on the course side, and ask the seller about stray balls, netting or damage and whether insurance was involved. The typical house was built in 2004, which tells you how old the roof and windows facing the course may be.

Pull the title. A right-of-way, covenant or setback can tie a lot to the course, and it shows on title, not on the listing. The typical lot was 6,317 square feet, so the course side is often a large share of the yard.
Visit at more than one time of day. Mowing starts early and summer evenings are busy. Golf course houses took 24 days to sell in South Surrey and White Rock, so there is time to go twice.
Compare the price with similar houses without the flag. The golf course median was $1,778,000 and the all-house median $1,670,000, so check whether size and age explain the gap.
